items.description: Pipe repair – replacement section, sealing, rock-wool insulation
items.rationale: Escape of water from a failed supply pipe is covered (2.4.2). Like-for-like materials, sealing and insulation are repair costs under 7.1.7(c). Rate taken from the summed material lines of the same claim in case 39 (pipe ~42+31, sealing 24, insulation ~42, fittings 51).

Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g). This flat rate summarises the labour hours of the case 39 draw (installer 1 h plus service technician about 9 h), so it is priced at that combined level rather than a single-hour rate; uncertainty is high.
One travel charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified under 7.1.7(f), and this is the only one on the invoice. Prior rate about 81.
Drying needed before closing the wall is covered under 7.1.7(b)/(e), once per drying operation. Prior about 439 (case 39 >=403).

items.description: Painting and closing the wall opening
items.rationale: Making good the opening needed to reach the pipe is covered under 7.1.7(a), limited to the affected patch. Prior about 453 (case 39 >=416).
